caption:
When's the last time you looked up at your vents? 👀

Fairfield County homeowners: every time the heat kicks on, the air blows right through all that dust. Two screws and the cover comes off. Vacuum out what you can reach, wash the cover, let it dry, screw it back in. Do every vent before you run the heat this winter.

Coming Soon: My House Guardian, to put this on the list for you. Send this to someone who's never taken a vent cover off.
